name: Esau
overview: The Scripture introduces Esau as the elder twin son of Isaac and Rebekah, whose birth was accompanied by a divine revelation that two nations would come from her womb, with the elder serving the younger. Isaac, at forty years old, took Rebekah as his wife after praying for her conception, resulting in the twins struggling within her. This background sets the stage for Esau's role as the progenitor of the Edomites and his complex relationship with his brother Jacob, highlighting God's sovereign plan in their lineage.
